name: VO2 4x4 moderate 48
description: Classic 4 x 4 min at about 90-95 percent of max heart rate, 3 min jog recoveries. Pace 10.5 km/h, level 1: set it from your ramp. Needs --running-mode, handrail up. See docs/treadmill/VO2MAX.md.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog, building gently. Last minutes just under the first rep pace.

steps.name: VO2 4 min
steps.notes: RPE 8-9: hard but controlled; the last rep matches the first.

steps.name: Recover
steps.notes: Easy jog or walk; let the breathing drop.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Jog then walk until the breathing is calm.
